facts.fact: The MoU says the planned Digital Governance Academy will also develop digital literacy programmes for citizen inclusion.

EMIS (Empresa Interbancária de Serviços) board chair José Marcos said more than 500,000 young people in Luanda and Benguela provinces had received digital-literacy training in two years under the Cidadão Digital project, costing about 400 million kwanzas, to be extended to Huambo this year.

Menos Fios reports, from a report by the interbank services company EMIS, that its Cidadao Digital project, run with public-private partnerships, has reached over 600,000 Angolans since 2022 with free digital literacy training in several provinces at community centres and schools, including rural areas.
